_notice: IMPORTANT FOR AGENTS: Do NOT delete or overwrite existing proposed events in this file. Only append new proposals. Secretary tracks processed/accepted proposals by their unique 'id' to prevent duplicate entries and calendar overlaps.

_eventTypes.call: Voice or video call (e.g. client calls, Zoom/Teams conferences, phone calls). Supports linking notes and collaborators.
_eventTypes.sync: Team synchronization or 1-on-1 meeting (e.g. daily standups, weekly 1:1, sprint planning). Supports linking notes and collaborators.
_eventTypes.prep: Preparation or follow-up buffer session associated with an upcoming or completed call/meeting.
_eventTypes.work: Focused deep work block (e.g. development, coding, writing, research, architectural analysis). Supports project tags and notes.
_eventTypes.todo: Scheduled execution session specifically dedicated to working on and completing a task from the Todo list.
_eventTypes.personal: Personal block or private appointment (e.g. lunch break, doctor appointment, personal errands, admin). Does not require tags or notes.
_eventTypes.ooo: Out of office / leave / vacation / travel / holiday. Blocks unavailable time; automatically hides project tags and notes.
_eventTypes.custom: Generic or flexible custom calendar block.
